messages.subject: Observability for Thicket
messages.body:
Hi Priya,

I came across Thicket's launch and wanted to reach out. Practice management software in veterinary is a space where uptime really matters—a scheduling outage during morning appointments can cascade through the entire day.

Meridian Stack helps early-stage B2B teams get production visibility without the engineering overhead of standing up your own observability stack. We're built for teams at your stage: pre-seed to Series A, shipping fast, where the first production incident usually happens before you've hired someone to own monitoring.

We work with a few other vertical SaaS companies (practice management for physical therapy, scheduling for salons) and the pattern is consistent: the cost of an outage in appointment-based businesses is high enough that basic monitoring pays for itself in the first prevented incident.

Would it make sense to show you what 15 minutes of setup gets you? Happy to do a working session where we instrument one service together.

Best,
Liam Chen
Meridian Stack

messages.subject: Resource: Post-mortem templates for small teams
messages.body:
Hi Priya,

Not a pitch—just sharing something that might be useful.

We put together a set of incident post-mortem templates designed for teams that don't have a dedicated ops person yet. It's the process we walked a few early customers through after their first production incident, now as a template you can use independently.

Includes:
- Blameless post-mortem structure
- Severity classification for small teams (what's a P0 when you're three people?)
- A timeline format that works in a Google doc

Free download, no email capture: meridianstack.io/resources/postmortem-template

Figured it might be helpful even if Meridian Stack isn't the right fit.

Best,
Liam
